transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. I really appreciate it. 

Um, well, I guess I've just been having a little trouble at work lately. I'm a retail buyer, and... I hope this doesn't sound crazy, I really don't want to come across like I'm just complaining or being a bad employee. But I just can't seem to shake this feeling that some of the people at work, and maybe even a few of our vendors, are... well, tracking my buys. Like they're purposely messing with the launch numbers just to make me look stupid. 

My supervisor actually sat me down and showed me the reports, and she says the paperwork doesn't prove anything like that is happening. So I came in because I want to figure it out. Maybe I'm just overthinking things? I just want to make sure I'm doing the right thing by being here. Does that make sense?
Have you ever heard voices, whispers, or other sounds that other people didn't seem to hear?

Um... I mean, I don't want to sound like I'm making things up, or like I'm, you know, going crazy. I know how this might sound. But... well, sometimes, yeah. 

Like, if I'm alone in the stockroom at work, or maybe driving back from meeting with a vendor... I'll hear this man's voice. It sounds like it's coming from right over my shoulder, right behind me. He'll say things like, 'Move faster, Scott,' or he'll just start laughing at the merchandise I picked out. But then I turn around, and... nobody's there. 

It's probably just stress, right? Like my brain is just working overtime because I want to do a good job? I really hope that doesn't make me sound too weird. Is that a normal thing to happen when you're stressed out?
Aside from the stress at work, how has your mood been lately—have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?

Oh, um, no, not really. I mean, I definitely don't want you to think I'm depressed or anything like that. I try really hard to keep a positive attitude, you know? 

I wouldn't say I feel sad or hopeless. Obviously, the situation with my vendors and the launch numbers gets me a little stressed out, but overall I think my mood is actually pretty good. I'm usually a pretty upbeat guy. 

I hope that's okay? Like, I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. But yeah, no persistent sadness or anything. I just try to push through and do my best so I don't let anybody down. Is that a normal way to handle it?
About how long have you been hearing that voice behind you?

Um, well... I guess it's been going on for a little while. I really didn't want to make a big deal out of it, you know? I just tried to put my head down and work through it. 

But, um, if I'm being completely honest—and I want to make sure I'm giving you all the right details—the voice, and also those feelings about people messing with my buys... it's been roughly ten months now. 

I hope I didn't wait too long to come in? I just really wanted to handle it myself so I wouldn't be a bother or make anyone worry. Does that make sense, waiting that long? I really hope I'm not doing this all wrong by letting it go on for ten months before asking for help.

latest_inference.note: Ruled out F23 due to symptoms persisting for 10 months (exceeding time criteria for acute/transient psychosis) and ruled out F25 due to absence of concurrent affective episodes.
